resolvedBehaviors.behavior: Complete cursor keys and accepted UTF-16 record/field/table identities
resolvedBehaviors.resolution: Build cursor keys from authoritative cells with the shared key function; use JSON-escaped exceptional SQL values and hex identity reads without changing logical IDs.

resolvedBehaviors.behavior: Existing UTF-16 contains semantics and null attachments
resolvedBehaviors.resolution: Keep normal instr and add byte-aligned boundary matching only for leading-low/trailing-high needles; guard legacy null attachment projections without backfill.

resolvedBehaviors.behavior: Initialization visibility and cancelled conversion start
resolvedBehaviors.resolution: Recheck visibility and preflight state within their write transactions; roll back failures and prevent cancelled-job revival.
Return the revision/metadata planned and committed by this write rather than reading a later writer state.
Compare field IDs exactly; atomically refresh search text after field caption/order changes without cell/history rewrites.
Retain the existing 80 UTF-16-unit bound so accepted writes remain readable by logical export.

resolvedBehaviors.behavior: Atomic snapshot import and bounded type state
resolvedBehaviors.resolution: Validate all snapshots before one batch; persist diagnostic record IDs instead of full column values while returning full caller diagnostics.

resolvedBehaviors.behavior: Question marks in identity literals and dead query branches
resolvedBehaviors.resolution: Remove unused generic placeholder replacement and unused physical-table query options; preserve active keyset, indexed and grouped paths.
Use valid byteSize fixtures and assert nonempty references through original parsing, filtering and cross-type ZIP restore.

resolvedBehaviors.behavior: Prototype-named cell fields and absent own values
resolvedBehaviors.resolution: Use Object.fromEntries to retain __proto__ as a data key and own-property reads in shared parsing/normalization, preserving existing missing-cell defaults without rejecting field IDs.
Keep literal anchors in instr; match only short prefix/suffix boundary patterns without restricting accepted needles.

resolvedBehaviors.behavior: D1 100 KB SQL limit for accepted wide views
resolvedBehaviors.resolution: Use shorter equivalent ->> option extraction for nonindexed select ordering; preserve index expressions and binding reuse.

queryComparison.boundary: Both SQL versions replay against the exact same pre-write local database. SQLite VM steps are not D1 billed reads or Workers CPU.
